kit.gallery.dragWidth: Drag to resize (arrow keys work too)
kit.gallery.wrapRow: Wrap degradation (label and control in different groups)
kit.gallery.smartRow.title: KitSmartRow · smart row
kit.gallery.smartRow.use: Several controls in one row where space varies: settings rows, toolbars, status lines. Floors are computed for you — you only tag priority.
kit.gallery.smartRow.avoid: Don't use it for multi-row lists, and don't stuff button groups in it — those belong in KitToolbar.
kit.gallery.page.title: KitPage · page shell (three scroll modes)
kit.gallery.page.use: The root of every ability page. document = long forms that scroll as a page; app = fixed header/footer with a scrolling middle; canvas = full-bleed pages (inner regions scroll, the shell only scrolls when content truly overflows).
kit.gallery.page.avoid: Don't hand-write calc(100vh - Npx) — the app bar's real height varies; absolute inset:0 needs no magic numbers.
kit.gallery.section.title: KitSection · section card
kit.gallery.section.use: A functional block on a page: title + one line of description + actions on the right. py-3 and action wrapping are built in.
kit.gallery.section.avoid: Don't use it as a list container — list rows belong in KitSmartRow / the upcoming KitListRow.
kit.gallery.section.plainBody: The default slot holds the body, 8px apart vertically.
kit.gallery.settingRow.title: KitSettingRow · settings row
kit.gallery.settingRow.use: The standard settings shape: name + control + value. Ships with two hard rules (no full-width slider, stepper by default on mobile) and drops straight into the settings v-row/v-col grid.
kit.gallery.settingRow.avoid: Don't hand-write justify-space-between + v-slider again — that's where 140 duplicated rows came from.
kit.gallery.optionalRow: Secondary setting (hides as a whole row)
kit.gallery.stepper.title: KitNumberStepper · number stepper
kit.gallery.stepper.use: Integer parameters in settings (follow counts, threads, cache size). ± are icon buttons (size=small allowed) with a 40px touch target.
kit.gallery.stepper.avoid: Don't use v-slider for numeric settings input — bili's gate flags any slider wider than 320px.
kit.gallery.stepper.draftNote: Try typing "12" then deleting a digit: nothing clamps mid-typing — only blur / Enter / ± commits.
kit.gallery.foundation.title: Grid · circle stat · placeholder
kit.gallery.foundation.use: KitGrid owns multi-column equal heights and a unified gutter; KitCircleStat is the reference implementation of the 80% content rate (diameter = text × 1.25); KitPlaceholder stands for a full-bleed content area.
kit.gallery.foundation.avoid: Don't hand-write grid-template-columns or diagonal stripes — gutter, radius and touch targets all come from the grid tokens.
kit.gallery.foundation.circlesNote: The diameter is derived from the text: box × 1.25 (i.e. text occupies 80%), clamped to 44–132px. Change the font size and the diameter follows.
kit.gallery.foundation.grid: Grid (equal columns / equal heights / unified gutter)
kit.gallery.foundation.gridNote: The number in each cell is its height (multiples of the 4px base unit); gutter 8px, radius 12px and the 40px touch target are all token multiples.
kit.gallery.foundation.placeholder: Placeholder (stands for a full-bleed content area)
kit.gallery.debugOutline: Layout self-check: outlines every element on this page and marks overflowing ones in red
